title: Two display-locale faces outside the objectui#9909 census: plugin-ai `NLQueryInput` formats its history date in the machine locale (the package has no i18n at all), and `useMetadataLocale` maps every non-zh language to `en-US` for Studio faces
body:
Filing gate ① — two product defects, each with a named site and a reproduction. They are filed as one card because both are the display-locale class that objectui#9909's repo-wide census cannot reach today, one for each reason it cannot. ⚠️ Split the card if triage grades or routes the two items differently.

Relayed from the objectui#9909 dev's report (`out_of_scope_findings`, PR objectui#10231), ⛔ not re-run by this seat. This seat re-read only what is stated in "verified" below.

## 1 · `packages/plugin-ai/src/NLQueryInput.tsx` — the query-history date in the machine locale (class a)

The published, registered `nl-query` component (with `showHistory`) renders `new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()`, which uses the **machine** locale. The package declares **no** `@object-ui/i18n` dependency and every string in it is hard-coded English: the unwired-component shape (precedent objectui#7173 vs #7142). ⇒ The objectui#9909 census, which scopes to packages that depend on `@object-ui/i18n` per the objectui#9786 ruling B′, does not see it. That PR left it unrepaired on purpose, because wiring the package means a manifest and lockfile change.
- Reproduction: render `NLQueryInput` with `showHistory` and one history item in a de-DE session. The date reads in the machine's convention, not the session's.
- Fix shape: wire `plugin-ai` to `@object-ui/i18n` as a whole (strings and display locale). The census then covers it automatically.
- Verified by this seat on `origin/main` `62597c5`: the objectui#9909 census table (`5741837422`) lists this exact expression under THIS DEFECT.

## 2 · `useMetadataLocale()` (app-shell metadata-admin) → literal `en-US` for every non-zh language (class b)

`StudioHomePage`'s `relativeTime` (`Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`) and `StudioDesignSurface`'s `savedAt` (`toLocaleTimeString`) format their faces with `useMetadataLocale()`. That hook maps every language other than zh to the literal `'en-US'`, so a de-DE session reads English/US faces (the objectui#4033 class: a declared wrong tag, not an absent one).
- Contract text it violates, `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts`: 「Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason.」
- `Seam: spec:useDisplayLocale doc contract (packages/i18n) → renderer:StudioHomePage relativeTime / StudioDesignSurface savedAt`
- Why the census does not catch it: the census flags bare, `undefined` and literal-tag call sites. A tag that arrives through a helper that returns a hard-coded constant is an expression it cannot resolve.

## Reader

The `domain:ui` execution seat (objectui#5560), for its queue once triage grades it. ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, type and priority are the triage seat's.
